job.name: pp2012
job.command: starver &starVersion; ls -ltrh ** # `$FILELIST` is the per-job list the scheduler dispatches (with maxFilesPerProcess=20 # it contains up to 20 input MuDst paths). The scheduler post-stages files locally and # updates $FILELIST to the local-scratch list before this command runs. # `makeTStarJetPico` passes it to `StMuDstMaker` which accepts either a `.list` or a single # `.root`, so this template works for both single-file (max=1) and multi-file (max>1) modes. # # Output name: we use `$JOBINDEX` (chunk index 0..N-1) — unique per chunk. Using # `$FILEBASENAME` here would collide because STAR scheduler sets it to "no_name" when # multiple input files are dispatched per process. root4star -l -b -q &rootMacro;\(\"$FILELIST\",\"&listBasename;_$JOBINDEX\",\"¯oConfig;\"\) >& ${JOBID}.log
